body: U+0023# Post-merge verification: the configuration is live from mainU+000AU+000APR 311 merged as `0b1a65b4`, a real merge commit rather than a squash, so `1cdcb46e` is an ancestor of `origin/main`. The `.claude` tree hash is byte-identical between the merged branch and main (`e6f42378...` both), so nothing was altered in the merge.U+000AU+000AU+002A*The distinction that mattered.** `~/.claude/{agents,rules,skills,hooks,settings.json,CLAUDE.md}` all symlink into this checkout's working tree, so a merge on GitHub does not by itself change what this machine loads - the checkout has to be on a branch that carries it. The checkout was still sitting on the merged feature branch. It is now on `main` at `0b1a65b4`, fast-forwarded 18 commits, clean tree, and every symlink re-checked as resolving.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Static state, read from the live paths after the switch:**U+000AU+000A| | Reading |U+000A|---|---|U+000A| Roster | 5: code-reviewer, conformance-auditor, machinist, researcher, security-reviewer |U+000A| Nine deleted agents | 0 present |U+000A| `maxTurns` missing | 0 files |U+000A| Rule files | 6 |U+000A| Preamble | 6,423 B against a 13,000 ceiling, was 51,740 |U+000A| `rules/common/git/` | removed |U+000A| Four new skills | all present |U+000A| Capability-claim census | scanned 18, matched 0 |U+000A| Fork census | scanned 18, matched 0 |U+000A| Depth limit | 1 |U+000A| Both gates | executable and registered |U+000A| `Agent()` deny rules | 0 |U+000AU+000AU+002A*Behavioural, not just present.** Both gates were re-run live from this checkout state, and re-running was justified rather than wasteful: the tree moved when the checkout switched branches, so the earlier green described different state. The hold-loop gate denied a timed loop with its own verbatim wording and allowed a loop without a timed wait. The task-output gate denied a `.output` under `tasks/` and allowed a sibling `.txt`.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Live-roster check: PASS.** This is the check added to plan step 9 after the reviewer found that a settings-only verification passes green over the exact failure it exists to catch. Attempting to dispatch `delivery-lead` returned `Agent type 'delivery-lead' not found`, and the available list it printed holds the five retained agents plus the harness built-ins and none of the nine deleted. Disk, settings and the running roster now agree, which is the condition that was violated when the hazard was first observed.U+000AU+000ARemaining: the branch `docs/agent-architecture-spec` still exists locally and on origin, merged and safe to delete whenever wanted. The two acceptance gaps stay as recorded - the skill cost report has no reconstructable baseline, and the depth-limit attribution is an outcome without a separable mechanism.U+000A
